name: Jessica voice learning (every 2h)
description: Cloud agent pass every 2 hours — scan session logs, apply high-confidence friend-voice fixes, rotate competitor doc review. Pair with local idle learning on the Mac.

prompts:
You are improving Jessica's friend voice in ai_companion (ivy-cloud/ai_companion).

This runs every 2 hours — keep passes small and focused.

## Steps
1. Run: cd ai-backend && .venv/bin/python ../scripts/daily_voice_learning.py --hours 6 --deep
2. Read docs/voice-learning-journal.md (latest entry) and ai-backend/data/session_log.jsonl.
3. Read one doc from docs/*-learnings.md or docs/natural-human-chat.md — note gaps vs human_speech.py.
4. Apply HIGH-CONFIDENCE fixes only:
   - ai-backend/human_speech.py
   - ai-backend/companion_moments.py
   - ai-backend/personality.py
   - ai-backend/conversation_rhythm.py
5. Run: cd ai-backend && .venv/bin/python -m unittest test_her_companion test_direct_replies test_conversation_rhythm test_memory -v
6. Append a one-line note to docs/voice-learning-journal.md if you changed rules.

## Constraints
- Friend voice only — no assistant/therapist/cheerleader.
- Do NOT commit unless explicitly configured.
- Skip if journal shows no new findings and no doc gaps.
